name: Ray-marched Volumetric Fog with Local Volumes and PCF Shadows
definition: A rendering pass that adds optional HDR height fog and volumetric direct-light scattering before TAA, bloom, and tone mapping. It integrates exponential height density and up to 16 transformed box volumes with additive extinction and Henyey–Greenstein scattering.
summary: This method renders HDR height fog by integrating local volumes along rays and using hardware PCF shadows at actual sample points to prevent light leakage.
